nodes.summary: An isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is a glide reflection if the determinant of its linear part is $-1$ and there are a line $L$ and a nonzero vector $v$ parallel to $L$ such that $f(x) = x + v$ for every point $x$ of $L$.
nodes.title: Glide reflection

nodes.summary: An isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is a reflection if there is a line $L$ such that $f(x) = x$ for every point $x$ of $L$, and the determinant of the linear part of $f$ is $-1$.
nodes.title: Reflection

nodes.summary: An isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is a rotation if it fixes some point $p$, the determinant of its linear part is $1$, and $f$ is not a translation.
nodes.title: Rotation

nodes.summary: An isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is a translation if there is a vector $v$ such that $f(x) = x + v$ for every point $x$.
nodes.title: Translation

nodes.summary: The linear determinant of an isometry $f$ of the Euclidean plane is the determinant of the linear part of $f$.
nodes.title: Linear determinant of a plane isometry

nodes.summary: Every isometry of the Euclidean plane is a translation, a rotation, a reflection, or a glide reflection.
nodes.title: Classification of plane isometries

nodes.summary: The Euclidean plane is the real vector space $\mathbb{R}^2$ with its standard inner product $\langle x, y \rangle = x_1 y_1 + x_2 y_2$.
nodes.title: The Euclidean plane

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
